confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded from aggregated London cost-of-living figures (Numbeo-based summaries, Finder, Morning Advertiser, City AM). Sources disagree and some are not dated to July 2026. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: cocktail uses London-centre guide ranges and wine uses glass-price ranges, with no pint-to-cocktail or pint-to-wine ratio applied. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of central London July rates; no booking pages or listings were checked. GBP was converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.33 USD per GBP, which was not sourced. The FX observation is the newest RBA figure found in search (20 March 2026), not verified as the latest observation on 19 November 2026; a more recent RBA observation may exist.
comparable_city_reasoning: London-specific basis for restaurant and drink anchors from aggregated cost-of-living and pub-price sources; accommodation from general model knowledge of central London, July peak-season levels, and comparable large European capitals. Pricing window is July 2026.
